name: Paint Drop
description: Drop paint and watch cozy pictures bloom. A calm color puzzle for adults, for iPhone and Android.
about: Relax with a new kind of coloring: drop paint and watch each picture bloom. Every level is a new picture. Aim the paint bottle and let the drops fly: each one fills an area with color. Finish the picture, add it to your album and go on to the next one.
play_data: The levels and sets you start and finish, restarts, time spent, your sound and vibration settings
settings_example: how often ads may be shown
ad_formats: a full-screen ad between levels and, if you choose to watch it, a short video that gives you more paint
